children: Germany digital marketing firm's nine-month sales fell 14% yr/yr to EUR 37.8 mln
Company reported nine-month EBIT of EUR 0.9 mln, up from break-even last year
Company confirmed full-year sales and EBIT margin guidance
Syzygy confirms 2026 sales forecast of around EUR 50 mln and EBIT margin of 3-4%
Company says focus remains on profitable new business and scaling AI-enabled services
Company notes market environment remains subdued
SALES DECLINE - In the core German market, sales for the first nine months amounted to EUR 29.1 million, down 18%, followed by Poland
EFFICIENCY MEASURES - Cost base adjustments and improved operating efficiency contributed to higher EBIT and margins
SEGMENT CONTRIBUTIONS - All segments delivered positive EBIT despite subdued market conditions
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Syzygy AG is €2.98, about 254.2% above its October 28 closing price of €0.84
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 14 three months ago
